A_TRAIN_all.exact_zero_note: Exact numeric equality to zero, not the nearstatic thresholds or rounding to a display precision.
A_TRAIN_all.persistence_note: At least5 of10 postsolve intervals need not be consecutive. These are co-occurrence/persistence sensitivity checks, not a causal pushing definition.
A_TRAIN_all.impulse_note: Existence of a valid postsolveAO norm above epsilon, not summed point/arc impulse, force or work.
A_TRAIN_all.operational_definition: At10Hz, noAO means no actual postsolveAO in any of10substeps; pusher moving means endpoint displacement>=.1image96px, not path length. Routing/recovery is only a planned approach/push/recontact free_route noAO candidate. Withdraw/static remain separate intended phases.
A_TRAIN_all.interval_duration_note: Classified0.1s control intervals are not the100Hz measured contact duration; overlapping denominator populations and repeated action-prefix exposures must not be added as acquired time.
A_TRAIN_all.causality: Contact plus displacement is observed co-occurrence, not a proof that all displacement was caused by the pusher.

sampler.order_policy: Exact frozen proposal first epoch; no redrawn order or category quota.

TRAIN_all.unit: one dominant actual postsolve arc per contacted control; unknown included

selected_target.unit: one dominant actual postsolve arc per contacted control; unknown included

VAL_all.unit: one dominant actual postsolve arc per contacted control; unknown included

action_prefix_weights.unit: Repeated input-action control exposures, not additional acquired physics time or independent samples

recontact.timing: First actual postsolve interval start at/after first planned recontact control; observed delays and right-censored failures kept separate.

failure_partial_scope: Six failed attempts and their costs remain separate from this912-successful-scene contact denominator; no failed controls are silently promoted to valid training targets.
no_contact_interpretation: No-contact nearstatic and no-contact residual/small/obvious movement remain separate; planned intent is not actual contact.
selected_subset_inference: Selected-target rates describe the fixed selected TRAIN pool. Deterministic negative selection is not an inverse-probability sample of the full library.
